rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when someone carries out a task conscientiously and takes it seriously.

example.english: I conscientiously completed the report without missing a single detail.
example.traditional: 我認真咁完成份報告，連一個細節都冇漏。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jing6 zan1 gam3 jyun4 sing4 fan6 bou3 gou3 lin4 jat1 go3 sai3 zit3 dou1 mou5 lau6

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on paying close attention or concentrating on the task.

example.english: I conscientiously paid close attention to the teacher’s explanation in class.
example.traditional: 上堂嗰陣，我專心咁聽老師講解。
example.jyutping: soeng5 tong4 go2 zan6 ngo5 zyun1 sam1 gam3 teng1 lou5 si1 gong2 gaai2

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on doing or checking something carefully and in detail.

example.english: They conscientiously checked every item before shipping it.
example.traditional: 佢哋仔細咁檢查每件貨，先至出貨。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 zi2 sai3 gam3 gim2 caa4 mui5 gin6 fo3 sin1 zi3 ceot1 fo3
